visualStyle.lighting: LA night, neon and news-van glow

analysis.themes: A petty thief becomes a freelance crime videographer and turns out to be exactly what the market wants — the American success story as sociopath origin tale.
analysis.atmosphere: Slick neon predation; LA at night becomes a hunting ground where the camera is the weapon.
analysis.narrative: A rise story with no moral correction — Lou escalates because every institution rewards his escalation.
analysis.visual: Gorgeous night-LA photography makes the ugliness seductive, which is the point.
analysis.characters: Lou Bloom speaks entirely in self-help and business jargon — a monster assembled from LinkedIn posts and market logic.
